changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.CatalogBrowseObject WITH SCHEMABINDING AS select I.ID as IntersectId, I.ObjectAssetID, I.SubjectAssetId, CAST(ADV_Object.DisplayValue as nvarchar(4000)) as ObjectDisplayValue, ADV_Object.DisplayValuePrefix, P.Id as PredicateId from dbo.[Predicate] P inner join dbo.[IntersectType] IT on IT.PredicateID = P.ID inner join dbo.[Intersect] I on I.IntersectTypeID = IT.ID inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue ADV_Object on ADV_Object.AssetID = I.ObjectAssetID where P.Type = 5;
